content: Pyramid canonical repository is fiatjaf/pyramid; v1.3.2 points to commit e12e816 dated 2026-07-29. Current code has three Go test files, no repository backup/restore or migration runbook, mutable base image tags, in-place binary update without checksum/signature verification, a shared mmap data directory, and multiple relay/services in one process. Current code also provides configurable limits, member hierarchy, NIP-29 groups, Blossom, and UI operations; maturity must be validated by staged drills rather than inferred from v1 tag.
